[EN] I know Castanica is worried about durignite for their shields, but they're running short on ore needed for the war effort, too.

{@RawItem:206807} is in particularly short supply. The good news is that you don't need to excavate an entire mine to get to it. Bring me some {@RawItem:206807}, and all of Castanica will shout your praises.
[ES] Sé que Castanica está preocupada por la durignita para sus escudos, pero también se están quedando sin el mineral necesario para el esfuerzo bélico.

{@RawItem:206807} es especialmente escaso. La buena noticia es que no necesitas excavar una mina entera para conseguirlo. Tráeme algo de {@RawItem:206807} y todo Castanica cantará tus alabanzas.

[EN] This is perfect. Thank you, .
[ES] Esto es perfecto. Gracias, .

[EN] With the mines shut down, Castanica is in crisis. Every little bit of {@RawItem:206807} helps, friend!
[ES] Con las minas cerradas, Castanica está en crisis. ¡Cada pequeño fragmento de {@RawItem:206807} ayuda, amigo!
